page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.8xlarge is a high-density local storage instance configured with 32 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The platform includes 128.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core under a KVM hypervisor, along with a 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth.

The primary hardware feature of this server is its bundled 94,489 GB local HDD storage configuration. Delivering substantial storage density directly on the physical host, this setup optimizes cost efficiency for high-capacity local disk space without requiring external network-attached volumes. However, the reliance on magnetic HDD storage presents standard hardware trade-offs, offering high capacity at lower random IOPS and higher latency compared to NVMe SSD instances.

With its combination of moderate vCPU compute power, standard memory allocation, and large local magnetic disk space, the instance is positioned for storage-heavy enterprise operations. Recommended workload fits include distributed file systems like Hadoop HDFS, big data analytics, log processing, data warehousing, and sequential batch processing tasks.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.8xlarge is a high-density storage instance designed for data-intensive processing and bulk storage requirements. Powered by 32 dedicated vCPUs from an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor operating at 2.5 GHz on x86_64 architecture, the instance incorporates 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. Its primary feature is an integrated 94,489 GB local HDD storage array, coupled with 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth running under a KVM hypervisor. The massive local HDD capacity provides significant cost efficiency for high-volume storage needs, though mechanical drive characteristics present lower random I/O performance relative to solid-state drives. This instance profile is suited for big data analytics, distributed file systems such as Hadoop HDFS, data warehousing, log processing, and large-scale batch ETL pipelines requiring large capacity.
